scope: Firebase Core 5.0.0 and Firebase Messaging 17.0.0 (Firebase Apple SDK 13, Android BoM 35)
Push target migrated from FCM registration tokens to Firebase Installation IDs (register()/onRegistered)
Gateway stores FIDs as fid:<FID> and sends with the FCM v1 fid field (token field fallback during the FID transition)
tests: repository required CI, Security, Tri-App (Android release build and native iOS simulator XCTest), Main Verification, and Release Policy checks
risk_notes: Firebase Messaging 17 is a breaking release: Firebase Apple SDK 13 and Android minSdk 24 (already the app's minSdk; iOS target already 15.0).
Clients on older app versions keep sending registration tokens; the gateway still accepts and sends them unchanged (token_type fcm_token).

Python firebase_admin releases without the Message fid field fall back to token=<FID>, which FCM v1 accepts only during the FID transition period; pin a firebase_admin release with fid support before that period ends.
rollback_steps: Restore pubspec.yaml, pubspec.lock, lib/mobile_security_service.dart, lib/push_service.dart, lib/main.dart, lib/omni_api.dart and omnidesk_agent/appsync/push.py/routes.py from the parent main commit.
Stored fid:<FID> push targets stay sendable by the fallback path; re-registering devices on the old app version replaces them with registration tokens.
